discharges: accuracy-matched C(epsilon) over the mapping x k grid

k_star_rule: k* is the set of rungs whose cost interval reaches the smallest upper bound; the interval is (C(confirmed_fail), C(confirmed_pass)], widened one grid step on any side R1 flagged environment-marginal
pass_rule: zero solver failures and the one-sided 95% nonparametric-bootstrap upper bound on RMSE <= 1.6 mHa
primary_metric: replica RMSE of the nonlinear selected-rank Ritz energy against the full exact ground energy, per (mapping, k) cell
